title: Dishes of Europe
intro: Which country is each dish from? Origins follow Wikidata, and many foods are shared across borders, so these are single-country origins only.

choices: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Spain as the country of origin of Esqueixada.
Wikidata gives Portugal as the country of origin of Molotof.

questions.prompt: Which country is Frutti di Martorana PAT from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Italy as the country of origin of Frutti di Martorana PAT.
Wikidata gives France as the country of origin of waffle.

questions.prompt: Which country is amatriciana sauce from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Italy as the country of origin of amatriciana sauce.

questions.prompt: Which country is leche frita from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Spain as the country of origin of leche frita.

questions.prompt: Which country is marble cake from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Germany as the country of origin of marble cake.
Wikidata gives Belgium as the country of origin of moules-frites.

questions.prompt: Which country is kotlet schabowy from?
choices: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Poland as the country of origin of kotlet schabowy.
Wikidata gives Hungary as the country of origin of gulyásleves.
